target: URL-only phishing classification relevant to Indonesia; decoded QR URLs share the same scope
window_interpretation: planned publisher observation/verification window for both classes, not proof of creation date or current safety
sampling: Freeze eligible public-source frames and their hashes before deterministic domain/tenant sampling. Do not sample by model score. Cap five URLs per domain/tenant; report domain support and source/structure coverage. Human audit error queues are not a sampling frame for final holdout.

source_roles.phishing_candidates: Public publisher/community evidence with case identifier and verification timestamp, followed by independent review of phishing scope and Indonesia relevance. A feed label alone is not local human gold.
source_roles.benign_candidates: Contemporaneous public evidence of legitimate URL purpose and ownership, independently reviewed. Include normal deep paths and hosted tenants; popularity, a .id suffix, an official-looking name or lack of a feed hit does not establish benign status.
source_roles.ranking_frame: A pinned public ranking may help form a candidate frame only; it supplies neither URL-level benign labels nor Indonesia relevance. Rights must be checked per source.

privacy: Use versioned redaction and manual privacy QA before storing URLs. Quarantine ambiguous sensitive inputs. Heuristic redaction is not full anonymization; record upstream representation changes and exclusions for both classes.
freeze: A custodian locks immutable candidate, review, adjudication, exposure and split manifests before any future fitting or policy selection. Keep final holdout labels out of development. This preparation file is not a locked dataset manifest.
metrics: precision on sampled cohort with prevalence caveat
